//| echo: false

All results on this page are hypothetical. They come from a backtest that applied fixed rules to historical data, not from actual trading. See the [methodology](../methodology.qmd) and [disclosures](../disclosures.qmd).

## Backtest summary

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
labels = ({
  "Compounding Annual Return": "Annual return (compounded)",
  "Sharpe Ratio": "Sharpe ratio",
  "Drawdown": "Maximum drawdown",
  "Total Orders": "Total orders"
})
fmt = v => v.endsWith("%") ? parseFloat(v).toFixed(1) + "%" : (v.includes(".") ? parseFloat(v).toFixed(2) : v)
html`<div class="stat-grid">${Object.entries(data.statistics).map(([k, v]) =>
  html`<div class="stat-tile"><div class="label">${labels[k] ?? k}</div><div class="value">${fmt(v)}</div></div>`)}</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<p><small>Backtest period ${data.meta.start} to ${data.meta.end}, starting value $${data.equity[0].value.toLocaleString("en-US")}. Run on QuantConnect, backtest ID <code>${data.meta.backtest_id}</code>, retrieved ${data.meta.retrieved}.</small></p>`
```

## Equity curve

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
equity = data.equity.map(d => ({date: new Date(d.date), value: d.value}))
Plot.plot({
  height: 340,
  marginLeft: 70,
  x: {label: null},
  y: {label: "Portfolio value ($)", grid: true, tickFormat: "~s"},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([equity[0].value], {stroke: "currentColor", strokeOpacity: 0.3, strokeDasharray: "4 4"}),
    Plot.lineY(equity, {x: "date", y: "value", stroke: "#0F6E56", strokeWidth: 1.5, tip: true})
  ]
})
```

The dashed line marks the starting value.

## Assumptions and limitations

- **Transaction costs:** TODO: state whether the backtest includes commissions and slippage, and which fee model.
- **Short window:** the backtest covers six years, which contain no recession and no sustained bear market. Results over a single period of that length say little about how the strategy would behave in other conditions.
- **Hypothetical results:** a backtest shows how fixed rules would have performed on past data. Past performance does not indicate future results.
